texts.zh:
闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
texts.en:
The screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

Clacking his beak furiously, he continues.

I request-- No, I DEMAND that we declare war! We can't let them destroy everything, not again! I... Together I believe we can prevent a repeat of what befell my people. I am ready to teach you everything we know.

label.zh: 你之前曾和这些威胁交过手吗？
label.en: Have you come into contact with this threat before?

responses.zh:
不，并没有。但我以前见过这种情况……这种模式再熟悉不过了。威胁是一样的。如果我们不尽快采取行动，我们将遭受到与我的留守同胞们同样的结局。

他全身的羽毛支棱了起来。

我不会再让任何人遭遇这种不幸了。
responses.en:
No, not exactly. But I've seen this play out before... The pattern is all too familiar. The threat is the same. If we don't act soon, we will meet the same end that once befell my people.

He ruffles his feathers.

I would not wish such a fate on anyone.

responses.zh:
我们将这种敌人称为“威胁”。他们从不回复任何通讯请求，更不用说外交，任何挡住他们去路的人后果都是死。

他发出了一声尖利的嘶鸣。

他们不知从何而来突然出现，烧杀抢掠！我们几乎没有还手能力，但我们知道了与这样的敌人作战意味着什么。常规战争是不够的。一不做，二不休。我们必须消灭他们，一个不留，否则就见不到明天了。
responses.en:
We called our enemy the Menace. They never responded to comms requests, let alone diplomacy, and everyone who got in their way wound up dead.

He emits a high-pitched scream.

They appeared out of nowhere, killing, mangling, burning! We had little chance to retaliate, but we learned what it means to fight such an enemy. Conventional warfare isn't enough. It must be total, or nothing. We must destroy all of them, every last one, or there will be no tomorrow.

responses.zh: 时间就是生命。我们必须加快这一进程。我们正面临着彻底毁灭的威胁。我们必须阻止这一切！
responses.en: Time is of the essence. We must expedite the process. We are facing the threat of total destruction. We must prevent this!

tooltips.zh: 该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。
tooltips.en: This project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.

label.zh: 我们不能在这里浪费资源。
label.en: We can't spend resources on this.

responses.zh:
斯克兰德尖叫了起来，

什么？！不……你犯了个十分严重的错误。
responses.en:
Skrand shrieks,

WHAT?! No... You're making a terrible mistake.

texts.zh: 我们被一股强大的力量所袭扰，这些东西试图摧毁我们所熟知的星系中的一切生命。斯克兰德提供了他的专业知识以及利爪号日志中相关的数据，但我们还需要一段时间才能完成全面的分析。
texts.en: We are beset by powerful forces that seek to destroy life in the galaxy as we know it. Skrand has offered his expertise as well as relevant data from the Talon's logs, but it will be some time before we can complete a comprehensive analysis.

texts.zh: 得益于斯克兰德对“威胁”作战的专长，及其提供的海量数据，我们现在面对这些涌现出来的天灾更加有备无患了。下一步就是将这些知识落到实处。
texts.en: Thanks to Skrand's expertise in warfare against the Menace, and the vast database he has provided, we are now much better equipped to deal with the emerging crisis. All that remains is to put this knowledge to good use.

texts.zh:
我们获得的数据库中可查询到一些斯克兰德的帝国时代这些威胁的作战方式实例。看来，他们使用的策略确实类似于我们今天所面对的那些。他们的舰队不使用正常的物流方案，通常是自给自足的。

更重要的是，干扰技术对他们不怎么起作用。破坏操作同样没有用。
texts.en:
The databanks we've accessed provide us with some examples of how the Menace fought during the time of Skrand's empire. It appears that they used tactics similar to those we face today. They rarely use standard logistical schemes, and their fleets are usually self-sufficient.

More importantly, jamming technology is not as effective against such forces. Sabotage operations are likewise useless.

texts.zh: 将我们与斯克兰德的数据进行对比得出了一些有趣的结论。似乎这些敌人相当地古板：它的大型舰队一次只聚焦在一个目标，而忽视其他所有的东西。我们应该可以识别他们的目标，并进行相应的防御。
texts.en: Comparing our own data to Skrand's, we have come to some interesting conclusions. It turns out that the enemy is quite inflexible: its largest fleets focus on one target at a time, to the exclusion of all else. It should be possible to identify such targets and defend accordingly.
